name: ht16k33_8x8
title: 8x8 LED matrix on an HT16K33
description: One 8x8 LED matrix on an HT16K33 backpack, on I2C: four contacts, two sockets of four beside them, A0 to A2 pads for eight addresses
notes: HT16K33 LED Backpack, Monochrome 8x8 Matrix on the back. What the two sockets of four carry is not printed. The matrix sits in holes of the backpack.

front.source: a photo by Anton of his module, 2026-11-13, straightened

back.source: a photo by Anton of his module, 2026-11-13, straightened and turned

photo.source: a photo by Anton of his module, 2026-11-13
photo.notes: + - D C over the holes on the front, SCL SDA GND VCC beside them on the back; HOLTEK HT16K33A on the chip; the pads A2 A1 A0 open.

levels.source: The volts of the HT16K33; the open pads give 0x70 by its datasheet. Whether the backpack pulls SDA and SCL up to VCC is not seen. Not tried.
